Maya C.: dropped the model bundle from VendorX into staging S3, placing manifest + artifacts under the onboarding path.
Maya C.: s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-lite/bundle-2026-03-20/ (weights + tokenizer + manifest + sig)
Ahmed P.: can you paste the sha256 for the main files? i'll run a quick verify :eyes:
Maya C.: sha256s (from vendor tar):
```
3f5b7a9c8d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9012ab3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7ab  aurora-lite-weights.tar.gz
c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566  tokenizer.zip
```
Maya C.: manifest.json (snippet):
```
{"name":"aurora-lite","version":"0.9","files":[{"path":"weights/aurora.pt","sha256":"3f5b7a9c...d7ab"},{"path":"tokenizer/vocab.json","sha256":"c1d2e3f4...45566"}],"signed_by":"vendorX-key-2026"}
```
artifact-bot: running provenance-checker v0.8
artifact-bot: CHECKSUM MISMATCH detected for tokenizer/vocab.json (expected c1d2e3f4...45566, got c1d2e3f4...45567) :warning:
Liz T.: could be a partial upload or gzip header issue. try re-downloading with `aws s3 cp` and recalc sha256 locally.
Sanjay R.: also verify the manifest signature: `gpg --verify manifest.json.sig manifest.json` and confirm the fingerprint matches vendorX-key-2026 on the vendor ACL.
Maya C.: re-uploading tokenizer.zip now from the vendor-provided bundle and will re-run checksum.
Maya C.: re-upload complete. new sha256 for tokenizer.zip is c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566
artifact-bot: provenance-checker OK. All checksums match. signature verified. :white_check_mark:
Priya I.: next: register the bundle into the staging registry with metadata and tags. example CLI: 
```
redwood-registry register \
  --path s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-lite/bundle-2026-03-20 \
  --env staging \
  --artifact-type model-bundle \
  --meta "source=vendorX,license=apache-2.0,ingest_by=maya"
```
Ahmed P.: add metadata: `quant: planned`, `eval-set: aurora-smoke-v1`, and `regression_watchlist: base-llm-latency,perplexity-delta` so infra knows downstream checks.
Liz T.: also create `smoke_prompts/` under the bundle (small set) and point registry `smoke_url` to it. that'll be used for quick quality regression checks post-quant.
Maya C.: registry entry created (staging). Intake ticket created: ML-3421. Included manifest, fingerprints, and a note: "4-bit quant experiments planned; do not promote to prod until quality guardrails pass."
Sanjay R.: reminder: for staging we use `redwood-ingest-kms-staging` for envelope encryption; prod key is `redwood-ingest-kms-prod`. make sure ticket lists the key used.
Priya I.: will schedule a canary bake: container that loads the bundle and runs 100 token perf + smoke prompts. target: >=100 tokens/sec on node-type g4dn.xlarge equivalent. If canary passes, we'll kick off quant benching pipeline.
Maya C.: added canary job to ML-3421, attached perf thresholds and smoke output example. tagging @eng-ml for visibility. closing out manual receipt checks. :white_check_mark:
